findings.description: Symmetry fallback threshold missing absolute value: left-skewed effects (g1 < -1.0) did not switch the primary test.
findings.disposition: FIXED: abs(skew) > threshold + negative-skew regression test (commit d890a7b, 19/19 tests).

findings.description: Review-coverage gate compares raw working bytes against git blob bytes; CRLF working copies break the seal for files stored as LF.
findings.disposition: FIXED at R482 level: the affected module is excluded from the byte-level review set and double-bound by the power artifact + seal sources (commit 4e1df63). A repository-wide eol pinning is a candidate infrastructure follow-up.

findings.description: Phase-3B coefficient clause mislabeled R433 base-reward constants as the penalty formula.
findings.disposition: FIXED: plan now registers the penalty as p_i = -mean_j(a_ij^2), lambda_p = 10.0, base = legacy.step_rewards unchanged (commit d890a7b).

findings.description: _profile_stress computed mean-square instead of the registered action-RMS metric (sqrt missing; ranks of paired diffs could differ).
findings.disposition: FIXED: per-step RMS sqrt(mean(a^2)) then mean over steps (commit d890a7b).
FIXED: registered in the plan (commit d890a7b).

findings.description: base/route commands lacked explicit WSL guards (failed closed only via absent artifacts).
findings.disposition: FIXED: explicit _assert_wsl_scratch added to base_audit and the route dispatch (commit d890a7b).

findings.description: Sign-flip fallback for ties/zeros was an unregistered extension.
findings.disposition: FIXED: plan registers the sign-flip test as the primary whenever the exact Wilcoxon is invalid (commit d890a7b).
